Logically speaking, since there was a power here that could kill Immortal King Haojun's fragment soul, in order to ensure the safety of the investigation, they should at least send an Immortal King over.
"However, there doesn't seem to be any killing intent on them." Cui Heng looked into the starry sky and fixed his gaze on Fang Jian and Immortal Monarch Chonghe.
After sizing them up for a moment, he chose to continue heading to the Point of Origin of the Origin of Stars to comprehend it.
As for these two sudden "guests", there would naturally be fake selves to entertain them.
To him, the most important thing now was to comprehend the Origin of Stars.
He strived to understand the truth of this world as soon as possible, complete the path to the Return to Void Realm, and complete a breakthrough in his cultivation realm.
The appearance of the guests from the Primordial World made Cui Heng feel extremely pressured and uneasy.
In his opinion, only by breaking through to the Return to Void Realm could he have a certain level of ability to protect himself.
... .
The process of the birth of the Netherworld shocked Fang Jian and Immortal Monarch Chonghe.
With Fang Jian's cultivation realm, he could not understand what this scene meant. He could only look at Immortal Monarch Chonghe beside him and ask, "Immortal Monarch, what was that just now?!"
In his nearly ten million years of life, he had never seen such a scene. Even when he was in the Myriad Heavens Palace, he had never heard of such a situation.
Has someone created a world and integrated it into this universe?!
It was simply unbelievable and exaggerated.

chapters.title: Chapter 682 Creating Reincarnation, Heaven's Will Reappears (2)
chapters.content:
"I, I'm not sure either." Chonghe shook his head and looked at the void in front of him in shock. He muttered, "There's actually such a mighty figure in this universe. Could this be the existence who destroyed Immortal King Haojun's fragment soul?!" As an Immortal Monarch at the peak of the Dao Heaven Realm, his knowledge could not be said to be limited. His realm could not be said to be low, and his strength could not be said to be weak. However, when he saw the huge world filled with the aura of death, he still felt his heart palpitate.
This meant that a peak Immortal Monarch like him was insignificant in contrast to that huge world. The other party only needed to divert a trace of his power to kill him.
"An Immortal King-level world?!" Immortal Monarch Chonghe could not help but exclaim. Then, he shook his head and said in a low voice, "No, I'm afraid this world's essence is even stronger than ordinary Immortal Kings. Is this a power comparable to a top Immortal King?!"
In the Primordial World, the Heaven Pass realm was called the Immortal King realm.
However, because the Heaven Pass Realm was actually divided into five small realms, and there was an extremely huge difference between each small realm. Even if they were all Immortal Kings, their strength might be different.
This naturally resulted in there being different terms of address for every level of Immortal Kings.
Ordinary Immortal Kings, Top Immortal Kings, Peak Immortal Kings, Invincible Immortal Kings, and existences who had already touched the Immortal Emperor realm and were respected as Quasi-Immortal Emperors.
The Immortal Kings of the Myriad Heavens Palace were Top Immortal Kings.
In Immortal Monarch Chonghe's opinion, the size and pressure displayed by the Netherworld was already enough to compare to a Top Immortal King.
There was actually a Top Immortal King expert in this universe?!
According to the cultivation system in the Chaos Sea, this person should be at the peak of the Taiji Realm. In the entire Immeasurable Universe, such experts were as rare as phoenix feathers and qilin horns.
Moreover, the conditions for breaking through to the Taiji Realm were extremely harsh, and the requirements for the environment of the universe were extremely high.
With the strength of the Great Dao laws in this universe, it did not look like it could nurture a Taiji Realm expert.
This made Immortal Monarch Chonghe feel deeply puzzled.
At this moment, Fang Jian, who was at the side, was already stunned. His eyes widened as he said in disbelief, "Immortal Monarch, what did you just say? This is a power comparable to a Top Immortal King?!"
"That's right." Immortal Monarch Chonghe nodded with a solemn expression, but he also said happily, "If I'm not wrong, this is an expert at the peak of the Taiji Realm. It's really our fortune."
"It's actually such a powerful existence." Fang Jian could not help but sigh. "With such an expert, even if the Myriad Heavens Palace really sends experts to attack, I'm afraid they can only return empty-handed."
"Return empty-handed?" Immortal Monarch Chonghe shook his head and said with a smile, "If an Ordinary Immortal King descends, it's unknown if he can return alive."
"Then what should we do next?" Fang Jian asked.
"We'll wait," Immortal Monarch Chonghe replied. "With this expert's cultivation realm, we should have been discovered when we came to this universe. He will definitely let us see him."
As if confirming his guess, just as he finished speaking, a door of light appeared in the void in front of him and a figure walked out.
This was an old man who looked like a sage. It was Daoist Su.
Just now, Cui Heng's fake self had found him and asked him to bring the two guests to the Immortal Land where Hong Fugui was.
Daoist Su looked at the two of them. His gaze was relatively calm when he saw Fang Jian, but when he saw Immortal Monarch Chonghe, he could not hide his surprise. He cupped his hands and said, "I'm here on Immortal Cui Heng's orders to welcome the two of you."
Immortal Monarch Chonghe also cupped his hands and bowed. "Thank you."
Fang Jian hurriedly bowed as well.
The two of them were also quite surprised. The person who came to welcome them was actually an expert at the Dao Ascension Realm.
In the Primordial World, this was also the Dao Heaven Realm.
It seemed that this universe was far stronger than he had expected.
... .
At this moment, Cui Heng's fake self was already waiting in the Immortal Land.
Peak Soul Formation cultivators already had traits of omnipotence, not to mention now that Cui Heng had stepped onto the path to the Return to Void realm.
Naturally, he could be at the Origin of Stars' Point of Origin and in this world at the same time.
While comprehending the Origin of Stars, it was normal for him to meet Fang Jian and Immortal Monarch Chonghe simultaneously.
He looked outside. Fang Jian and Immortal Monarch Chonghe had already followed Daoist Su here.
Looking at the approaching palace, Fang Jian and Immortal Monarch Chonghe were a little nervous.
They did not know what Immortal Cui Heng's attitude was and felt a little uneasy.
After all, this might be an expert comparable to a Top Immortal King who could decide their life and death with a thought.
However, when they arrived at this palace, they could not help but calm down. They actually felt like they had returned to the place where life began.
It was incomparably quiet and peaceful.
When they walked to the deepest part of the palace and saw the figure sitting at a high place with a smile, they felt their bodies and minds sublimate, as if they had seen the most mysterious origin in the universe.
At this moment, Fang Jian and Immortal Monarch Chonghe were enlightened. They knelt on the ground almost at the same time and bowed respectfully to Cui Heng. "Greetings, Exalted Immortal!"
"Alright." Cui Heng nodded slightly and smiled. "Please rise. Why are the two of you here?"
"Thank you, Exalted Immortal." Immortal Monarch Chonghe stood up, his attitude still very respectful. He asked, "Exalted Immortal, do you still remember Immortal King Haojun?"
"I see." Cui Heng came to a realization when he heard that. He smiled and said, "His fragment soul died here and was sensed by the other fragment souls. Are you here to capture me?"
"No, no, no!" Immortal Monarch Chonghe immediately jolted and waved his hand to deny it. "We came here to inform you that you had been noticed by the Primordial World and wanted you to go to another universe to take refuge. We didn't expect you to already be a Top Immortal King."
Top Immortal King?

chapters.title: Chapter 683 Creating Reincarnation, Heaven's Will Reappears (3)
chapters.content:
Cui Heng's eyes narrowed slightly when he heard this. He knew very well that he had yet to truly break through to the Early-stage Return to Void Realm and had only walked a distance on the path to the Return to Void Realm. This was already the level of a Top Immortal King?
Could it be that the Immortal Emperor realm was actually only equivalent to the High-grade Return to Void realm?
It couldn't be.
Thinking of this, Cui Heng looked at the two of them and smiled. "Even if I'm a Top Immortal King, it doesn't mean that there's no danger. What you mean by refuge is…"
At this point, he suddenly felt a chill run down his spine. He looked outside and stood up. "It seems like it's too late now. Someone was chasing after you."
"Exalted Immortal, it should be the Heaven Lord of the Myriad Heavens Palace, Han Shenyi," Immortal Monarch Chonghe said. "He's only a Peak Dao Heaven Immortal like me. He's equivalent to an Ancient King in the Boundless Universe.
However, there will most likely be Immortal Kings setting up arrangements on him to let him unleash the strength of an Immortal King. Exalted Immortal, you have to be more careful."
"Alright." Cui Heng nodded. Then, he raised his eyebrows slightly and said with a smile, "Interesting. There doesn't seem to be just one person… No, this aura…"
The smile on his face froze, and he frowned. "Is it Heaven's Will?"
"Heaven, Heaven's Will?" Immortal Monarch Chonghe and Fang Jian were stunned.
Wasn't the will of this universe Immortal King Haojun's fragment soul? It should have been killed long ago.
… .
While Fang Jian and Immortal Monarch Chonghe were meeting with Cui Heng, Han Shenyi finally arrived at this universe carefully.
However, when he arrived, Cui Heng had already ended his creation of the Netherworld. He had also left the Netherworld and headed to the Point of Origin of the Origin of Stars.
Therefore, the universe was no longer filled with the dense aura of death and had returned to its normal state. It looked like an ordinary universe.
"An expert who can kill a fragment soul of an Immortal King. I want to see how capable you are to actually have such guts!"
Han Shenyi stood in the starry sky and instantly locked onto all the experts who had surpassed the Dao Realm in this universe. Then, he moved towards one of them.
He planned to kill these people first to vent his anger.
However, what Han Shenyi did not notice was—
At the same time that he came to this universe, an existence that he could not sense had attached itself to him and descended into this world.
When Han Shenyi went to attack the experts of this universe, this mysterious existence stayed where he was.
His perception quickly spread out. The entire universe seemed to have shrunk under his perception. Soon, he located a star in a remote star region.
Dark Sea Star.
This mysterious existence crossed the vast void and his gaze landed in the core of the Dark Sea Star.
There was an ancient palace there. He spoke slowly and muttered.
"Juntian Palace…"

chapters.title: Chapter 684 Prologue Begins, Heavenly Heart Mist
chapters.content:
"In terms of the cultivation system of the Immeasurable Universe, there are 23 experts at the Dao Ascension Realm and 12 experts at the Dao Self Realm."
Han Shenyi's perception was extremely powerful, and he quickly discovered the number of experts in this universe. "They're stronger than I expected, but such a universe shouldn't be able to give birth to experts who have surpassed the Dao Heaven Realm..."
Moreover, where is the expert who killed Immortal King Haojun's fragment soul? I can't even sense his whereabouts. Is he hiding?"
Actually, Cui Heng did not deliberately hide himself.
However, he had already completely comprehended two Origin Great Daos and completely grasped these two powers. To a certain extent, he was already standing at a level higher than these two Origin Great Daos.
With Han Shenyi's current cultivation at the Peak of the Dao Heaven Realm, even if he used a secret treasure that could detect the existence of a higher realm, it was impossible for him to detect Cui Heng's location.
"In that case, I can only question those people at the Dao Self Realm."
Han Shenyi quickly made a decision and teleported quickly in the void of the universe. In the blink of an eye, he arrived at the location of an expert above the Dao Realm.
This was a world filled with the aura of the sun. The sun hung high in the sky, and the warm sunlight illuminated the ground, nourishing all living beings.
Unlike ordinary worlds, this sunlight also contained extremely dense nomological power, allowing every living being illuminated by the sunlight to have power that far exceeded ordinary living beings.
This was an Immortal Land evolved from the Sixth Heaven fragment of the Yang Immortal Domain back then, and it was also the current dojo of Jin Lingshi.
Therefore, Jin Lingshi had almost absolute control over this Immortal Land. Under normal circumstances, no change could escape her perception.
However, Han Shenyi's cultivation realm far exceeded hers. It was only when Han Shenyi arrived in front of her that she sensed him.
Jin Lingshi was a beautiful woman who looked to be in her thirties. She wore a golden dress and had a golden bell hanging at her waist. Her entire body emitted a mature charm.
She was not flustered by Han Shenyi's sudden arrival. She only slowly stood up and smiled. "Your cultivation is far above mine. May I know why you're here?"
"I'll ask you a question. If you answer it correctly, you can live. If you answer it wrongly, your body and soul will be destroyed." Han Shenyi's expression was cold as he said in a low voice, "Where's the person who destroyed Heaven's Will?"
"I don't know." Jin Lingshi shook her head gently and smiled faintly. "However, I know that you're here to court death. No matter what realm you're in or what cultivation you have, when you face him, there's only death."
In the previous battles, she had personally seen the various powers Cui Heng used. It was an omnipotent power, and it was impossible for anyone to compare to it.
It was too powerful.
"You really don't know what's good for you." Han Shenyi sneered. Then, he stopped asking and raised his palm to grab the top of Jin Lingshi's head.
He planned to search her soul.
However, at this moment, Jin Lingshi's figure disappeared from the spot without warning, as if she had never existed.
Han Shenyi's movements immediately froze. He frowned as he looked at the place where Jin Lingshi had disappeared. His eyes narrowed slightly as he said in surprise, "That power aura just now doesn't look like the Taiji Realm, nor does it look like the Heaven Pass Realm."
Just now, when Jin Lingshi disappeared, a bolt of energy had flashed past.
This power was very powerful and completely exceeded the limits of the Dao Heaven Realm, but it was not any power he knew.
It was very strange.
"This person must have a great secret." Han Shenyi thought to himself, "This power is mysterious and powerful. I can't let him continue to become stronger. I have to kill him as soon as possible."
Thinking of this, he locked onto another Dao Ascension Realm expert and instantly teleported over.
This time, it was King Haoran, who was originally from the Cang Immortal Domain.
However, King Haoran seemed to have sensed the danger in advance. Before Han Shenyi arrived, he disappeared like Jin Lingshi.
"They have a way to communicate with each other?" Han Shenyi's frown deepened.
In this situation, it was obvious that Jin Lingshi had informed King Haoran, giving him a chance to hide in advance.
After realizing this, Han Shen sent out his perception again, but he realized that more than half of the Dao Ascension Realm experts who he had already confirmed their location had disappeared.
Moreover, these people who had disappeared were all from the area with the densest nomological spirituality in this universe. The rest were basically in the desolate areas.
"These people should know where that person is and have made preparations in advance." Han Shenyi thought to himself.
Then, a cold smile appeared on his face. "Since you value your life so much, I don't think you'll care that all living beings die because of you."
As he spoke, Han Shenyi's body glowed with a faint golden light.
At the same time, an incomparably powerful force swept across the ground where King Haoran was, instantly killing all the living beings here.
In the next moment, he returned to the place where Jin Lingshi was and directly killed all the living beings here. All of them were destroyed in body and soul.
Next, Han Shenyi went to the worlds where the Lord Changsheng, Lord Tianzhu, the Formless God, and the others were. He killed all the living beings in these worlds.
He was completely unscrupulous.
At this moment, in the "Third Heaven World" that Cui Heng had established, Jin Lingshi, King Haoran, Lord Tianzhu, Lord Changsheng, and the others were all here. They looked at the scene displayed on the light curtain with faces filled with anger.
This "Third Heaven World" was originally established by Cui Heng to replace the venue for the banquet.

chapters.title: Chapter 685 Prologue Begins, Heavenly Heart Mist (2)
chapters.content:
Therefore, as members of the banquet, Jin Lingshi, King Haoran, Lord Tianzhu, and the others all had the right to enter this world at any time. Moreover, after entering this world, they could directly send messages to the other members.
Hence, this place surprisingly became their refuge.
However, after coming here, they were still a little uneasy, so they used the special functions of this world to keep tabs on Han Shenyi's current situation.
However, what they saw made their eyes almost pop out.
Many of the living beings killed by Han Shenyi were their descendants, successors, and even personal disciples.
Now, their bodies and souls had been destroyed!
"This person will definitely be killed by Immortal Cui Heng if he massacres people like this!" Tianzhu Lord said in a low voice. "We just have to wait quietly. Immortal Cui Heng will definitely attack!"
"That's right!" Lord Changsheng nodded at the side, but he said worriedly, "I'm afraid he's killing so wantonly to attract Immortal Cui Heng's attention. Could it be that he really has the confidence to resist Immortal Cui Heng?"
"That's impossible." Jin Lingshi shook his head and said, "You and I have seen Immortal Cui Heng's strength before. He's an omnipotent existence."
"But this person might have come from outside our universe," King Haoran said in a low voice. "The aura of power on his body is completely different from ours. He's out of place."
"Now, we can only hope that Immortal Cui Heng can kill this person." The Formless God sighed softly.
... .
Han Shenyi's killing continued.
After killing all the living beings in the worlds of those Dao Ascension Realm experts, he turned his target to the ordinary Star Seas.
A peak Dao Heaven realm Immortal Monarch was equivalent to a Grand Primordium Ancient King. This was already the limit of what could be achieved in this universe.
Back then, the Human Monarch and the Lord of the Immortal Domains were at this level.
Therefore, when the living beings of the ordinary Star Seas faced the attack of an expert like Han Shenyi, they had no ability to resist at all.
In fact, most people did not even feel anything before they were killed by Han Shenyi.
An incomparably powerful force spread out unscrupulously, instantly enveloping billions of stars.
In the blink of an eye, countless living beings died.
Such a situation naturally could not be hidden from Cui Heng's perception. While he paid attention to the movements of the Dark Sea Star's Juntian Palace, he also began to pay attention to Han Shenyi.
"He's about equivalent to a Peak Soul Formation realm cultivator with 480 million fake selves." Cui Heng thought to himself and estimated Han Shenyi's strength.
If it was a thousand years ago, before he stepped onto the path to the Return to Void Realm, it would be relatively troublesome to face such an expert. He had to use the Sky Demon Disintegration Technique to increase his strength in a short period of time to resist him.
However, now that he had already stepped onto the Path to the Return to Void Realm and had completed his comprehension of two Origin Great Daos, his strength was already incomparable to before.
Any strand of his hair could crush countless Han Shenyi.
The reason why he did not attack immediately was because Cui Heng had discovered a strange power in Han Shenyi's body.
This strange force was connected to an unknown place outside the universe, and it was stirring, as if it could descend at any time.
Through tracing the source of this power, he could locate the unknown place outside the universe.
"Is this the so-called Immortal King power?" Cui Heng thought of the information he had mentioned to Immortal Monarch Chonghe earlier and was a little puzzled. "But is this level of power enough to make him so fearless?"
He, who had always been careful, could not understand Han Shenyi's mentality. Could he do whatever he wanted just because he had a powerful trump card?
This was courting death.
Although Han Shenyi possessed the power of an Immortal King that could descend at any time, Immortal Kings were also divided into several levels. Even if it was the power of a Top Immortal King, there were still realms like the Peak, Invincible, and Quasi-Immortal Emperor realms above that.
Could it be that this person was not afraid of meeting an expert of a similar realm and directly killing him?
Cui Heng's gaze passed through the endless void and stared at Han Shenyi, who was killing wantonly. He shook his head and sighed. "Simply unreasonable."
He casually looked at the Netherworld that had just been established.
At this moment, many fake selves born from the Origin of Death were constructing the Netherworld Palace.
Actually, there was no need to do it so urgently.
But now, there was an unexpected situation.
Han Shenyi killed without restraint, causing countless living beings to die.
After these living beings died, they all came to the Netherworld. The Netherworld that was originally empty suddenly became filled with "people".
Many Death Gods, Nether Lords, Burial Gods, and other fake selves also became extremely busy.
They had to manage these undead.
As these undead were basically innocent people who had died in vain, they did not have any intelligence after entering the Netherworld. They were all muddle-headed and only had the instinct to strengthen their souls.
If they did not manage this situation, there would definitely be trouble.
Moreover, these undead would most likely be revived by Cui Heng in the future, so they naturally could not let them devour each other.
It could be considered as letting these fake selves train in advance to familiarize themselves with their future business.
These people who had taken a trip through the Netherworld would become stronger and more tenacious after reviving. It could be said to be a blessing in disguise.
Then, after Han Shenyi killed hundreds of billions of living beings in the Star Seas, Cui Heng's gaze finally focused. He had successfully locked onto the unknown place outside the universe.
It was the Primordial World.
This also meant that from now on, as long as he wanted to, he could enter the Primordial World at any time.
He could even attack from this universe and project his power into the Primordial World.
Of course, the commotion caused by the method was too great, and it was very likely to alarm some supreme existences. Unless it was necessary, he would not do this.

chapters.title: Chapter 686 Prologue Begins, Heavenly Heart Mist (3)
chapters.content:
Even if it was just to probe that world, he planned to wait until he truly broke through to the Return to Void Realm. "Now, there's no need to keep you," Cui Heng muttered.
At the same time, his gaze returned from the endless void and landed on Han Shenyi, who was killing wantonly.
Han Shenyi, who was immersed in the slaughter, suddenly felt his entire body stiffen. His body and soul seemed to have been frozen, and he could not even move a finger.
"He's attacking!" Han Shenyi was shocked and immediately called out, "Immortal King, please descend!"
In the next moment, the strange power contained in his body began to soar. It instantly increased by billions of times and quickly replaced the original power in his body.
"It's indeed here!" Cui Heng raised his eyebrows slightly and was about to attack from afar to suppress this Immortal King power.
But at this moment, the mysterious existence that had possessed Han Shenyi and came to this universe and headed to the Juntian Palace suddenly rushed out.
Then, he broke through the void and crossed a distance of billions of light years to appear in front of Han Shenyi.
Then, his entire body turned into a ball of white mist that enveloped Han Shenyi.
This sudden change stunned Cui Heng. He frowned and stared at the strange white mist. He said in a low voice, "This... what is this?!"
At the same time, in the Myriad Heavens Palace in the Primordial World.
A Heaven Pass Immortal King was floating in the void and sitting cross-legged. Green light lingered around his body, bright and dazzling.
These green lights contained his Immortal King power. They entered the void three feet away from him and disappeared, as if they had seeped into an unknown place.
He was one of the two Immortal Kings of the Myriad Heavens Palace, Cheng Yuan.
However, in the understanding of most people, the Myriad Heavens Palace only had a Top Immortal King called Cheng Shang.
They did not know about the existence of Cheng Yuan.
This person was Cheng Shang's 12th generation grandson. After nurturing him for countless years, he finally secretly became an Immortal King.
This time, Cheng Shang had arranged for Han Shenyi to descend to the Lower World. On one hand, he was indeed going to clean up the people who had killed Immortal King Haojun's fragment soul. On the other hand, he wanted Cheng Yuan to familiarize himself with the use of his Immortal King power.
If nothing unexpected happened, there shouldn't be any accidents.
After all, it was not difficult for a true Immortal King to kill someone whose strength had surpassed the Dao Heaven Realm but might not be at the Heaven Pass Realm.
Even if that person already had the strength equivalent to an Immortal King, there would not be any problems.
That was because Cheng Shang was guarding Cheng Yuan the entire time.
Once he discovered that the situation was wrong, he would send his power over and crush them with the power of a Top Immortal King.
But suddenly, Cheng Yuan, who was sitting cross-legged with his eyes closed, turned pale. Strange white mist suddenly surged out of his seven apertures, wanting to envelop his entire body.
When Cheng Shang saw this, his face immediately revealed an expression of disbelief. He exclaimed in extreme shock, "Heavenly Heart Mist, it's the Heavenly Heart Mist!
"Someone, quickly go to the Wujue Palace to report urgent news to Immortal King Wujue. The Heaven's Will of the Chaos Sea has grasped the power left behind by the Supreme God of Heaven!
"Immortal King Wujue, please destroy that universe!"

chapters.title: Chapter 687 Legacy Of The Supreme God Of Heaven, The End Of The Path To The Return To Void Realm
chapters.content:
The Heaven Pass Realm was not just a single level. It was divided into five minor realms.
Therefore, even if they were both Immortal Kings, there were still differences in realms.
Immortal King Wujue was an outstanding Immortal King. He was an Immortal King expert who had surpassed the level of Top Immortal King and reached the Peak Immortal King realm.
Such an existence could be said to be as rare as phoenix feathers and qilin horns in the entire Primordial World. He was definitely a big shot.
Although the Myriad Heavens Palace was powerful and had a Top Immortal King, it was far from being comparable to the faction established by a Peak Immortal King.
In fact, the Myriad Heavens Palace should be one of the subordinate organizations managed by the Wujue Palace.
It was precisely because of this that when Cheng Shang, a Top Immortal King, discovered something he could not deal with, his first reaction was to ask for help from Immortal King Wujue.
While Cheng Shang sent someone to ask Immortal King Wujue for help, he was also using his full strength to suppress the Heavenly Heart Mist that surged out of Cheng Yuan's body.
The power contained in this white mist was extremely strange and powerful.
Even a Top Immortal King like Cheng Shang could only barely suppress it so that this strange white smoke would not completely corrode Cheng Yuan.
After the Heavenly Heart Mist was suppressed, Cheng Yuan, who was originally unconscious, gradually woke up.
"Ancestor, what happened just now?" Cheng Yuan frowned and asked, "Wasn't I transferring power to Han Shenyi? Why did I suddenly lose consciousness?"
However, at this point, he realized that something was wrong with his current situation.
Looking at the strange white mist around him, Cheng Yuan seemed to have thought of something and exclaimed in shock, "This, this is the Heaven Heart Fog. Was I corroded by the Heaven Heart Fog just now?!"
"That's right." Cheng Shang nodded and said, "In the universe where Han Shenyi went, the Heaven's Will that controlled the power left behind by the Supreme God of Heaven has appeared. It even attacked Han Shenyi and corroded you with your Immortal King power."
"Damn it!" Cheng Yuan's expression became incomparably gloomy. "If not for you, Ancestor, I would probably have been devoured by the Heaven Heart Mist and become nourishment for that universe for no reason. Damn it!"
"He's going to die soon." Cheng Shang sneered. "I've already sent someone to the Wujue Palace to inform Immortal King Wujue about this. That universe will be destroyed soon. At that time, the Heaven Heart Mist wrapped around your body will also dissipate."
The so-called Heaven Heart Mist was actually the power left behind by the Supreme God of Heaven.
Legend has it that the Supreme God of Heaven had transformed into the laws of the boundless Chaos Sea, and it was also the origin of the Great Dao laws of the current Immeasurable Universe.
The will of the universe was nurtured from the Great Dao laws.
The source of Heaven's Will was actually the Supreme God of Heaven.
Therefore, every Heaven's Will had a chance to return to its original state and grasp a trace of the power of the Supreme God of Heaven.
This trace of power was the power left behind by the Supreme God of Heaven, and it was also called Heaven's Will Power.
Different levels of Heaven's Will had different levels of control over the power left behind by the Supreme God of Heaven. There was naturally a difference in power.
The external manifestation of this power had different states.
Currently, there were three known states of Heaven's Will Power--
Mist, Light, Phenomena.
Among them, Heaven Heart Mist was the most basic state, and Heaven Heart Light was much stronger. Heaven Heart Phenomenon was the highest level of mastery of Heaven's Will Power within the known range.
However, this was a power left behind by the Supreme God of Heaven after all. Even the most basic Heaven Heart Mist had extremely terrifying power.
As long as any Heaven's Will grasped the Heaven Heart Mist, they would possess strength comparable to a Top Immortal King. Moreover, they could devour Immortal King experts to strengthen the universe under their control.
Of course, if that was all, it was not enough to make the experts of the Primordial World feel fear.
What really terrified the Primordial World was the growth and indestructibility of the Heaven's Will who grasped Heaven's Will Power, as well as the almost terrifying "infectiousness" of their power.
Growth refers to the fact that after a Heaven's Will grasped the Heaven's Will Power, it could continuously become stronger even if it did nothing.
A Heaven's Will in the Heaven Heart Mist state only needed to hide for a billion years to evolve to the level of the Heaven Heart Light. Its strength would also increase by leaps and bounds, directly reaching the level of an Immortal Emperor.
In another billion years, this Heaven's Will would reach the level of Heaven Heart Phenomenon. It would grasp a large number of Supreme God of Heaven techniques and become an existence that surpassed the Immortal Emperor realm and was enough to challenge an Immortal Ancestor.
The indestructible characteristic referred to the fact that the Heaven's Will that had grasped the Heaven's Will Power was almost impossible to kill.
In the state of the Heaven Heart Mist, as long as the universe that gave birth to this Heaven's Will was not destroyed, it could never be killed. Even an Immortal Emperor could not kill it.
If one reached the state of the Heaven Heart Light, even if the universe that gave birth to this Heaven's Will was destroyed, it could use the will of the other universes to revive and become even harder to kill.
If it reached the state of the Heaven Heart Phenomenon, the Heaven's Will would completely become impossible to kill. At the very least, no Heaven's Will at the Heaven Heart Phenomenon level had been killed so far.
On the other hand, a few Immortal Ancestors in the Primordial World were killed by the Heaven's Will.
The contagious effect of their power was even more terrifying.
As long as a Heaven's Will that grasped the Heaven Heart Light appeared, the Heaven's Wills from the surrounding universes would also grasp the Heaven Heart Mist.
This would cause the number of Heaven's Wills that grasped the Heaven's Will Power to rapidly expand.
It could be said that these experts who had grasped the Heaven's Will Power were the greatest source of confidence in the Boundless Chaos Universe, and also the greatest reliance they had to counterattack their original world.
Therefore, the Primordial World was very firm in their attitude towards the Heaven's Wills that had grasped the Heaven's Will Power.
Kill!
Not a single one will be spared!
As long as they discovered such a Heaven's Will, they had to destroy the universe that the Heaven's Will resided in as well and try their best to kill the Heaven's Will.
They could not let the Heaven's Will evolve to the point of mastering Heaven Heart Light.

chapters.title: Chapter 688 Legacy Of The Supreme God Of Heaven, The End Of The Path To The Return To Void Realm (2)
chapters.content:
It was true that the universe that discovered the Heaven's Will might not be the universe that was born from the Heaven's Will. Even if this universe was destroyed, it might not be able to kill the Heaven's Will. However, to the Primordial World, it was enough as long as there was a faint possibility. In any case, it was only destroying a universe in the Chaos Sea and had no effect on the Primordial World.
… .
In the Wujue Palace.
The envoy sent by Cheng Shang knelt on the ground respectfully and kowtowed to a man sitting on the jade platform. "…Supreme Venerate Wujue, that's what happened. Immortal King Cheng Shang requests you to take action and destroy that universe."
Wujue was a middle-aged man wearing a pure black robe, giving off an extremely deep and unfathomable feeling.
After hearing the situation described by this envoy, Wujue frowned slightly and said in a low voice, "There's actually another Heaven's Will that has grasped the Heaven Heart Mist?"
At the same time, he was even more bewildered.
"In the past ten million years, three Heaven's Wills that have grasped the Heaven Heart Mist have appeared in succession. If this is true, it's the fourth.
In such a short period of time, four have appeared. Isn't that too many? Could it be that a Heaven's Will that has grasped the Heaven Heart Light has been born?
No matter what, I should destroy this universe first. Even if I can't kill this Heaven's Will, I won't be blamed."
Thinking of this, Immortal King Wujue slowly walked down from the jade platform and looked down at the envoy. He said indifferently, "Get up and bring me to the Myriad Heavens Palace to see Cheng Shang."
The Myriad Heavens Palace was a treasure with a special use. It could directly project the power of an Immortal King into the boundless universe of the Chaos Sea.
If he wanted to destroy a universe, he had to go to the Myriad Heavens Palace.
… .
At this moment, the Myriad Heavens Palace had already entered a combat state. Most of the people were gathered together to pay attention to the universe where the Heaven Heart Mist had appeared.
Other than Han Shenyi, the three Heaven Lords also personally took action. They tried their best to activate the special effect of the Myriad Heavens Palace and condensed a light curtain, revealing the scene in the universe.
Han Shenyi floated in the starry sky. Thick white mist had already enveloped his entire body and devoured the Immortal King power contained in his body.
Clearly, this was the Heaven Heart Mist devouring power on Immortal Kings. Moreover, while devouring the power of the Immortal King, it was also releasing it to strengthen this universe.
Cheng Shang and Cheng Yuan were also here. When they saw this situation, they could not help but feel happy.
Since this Heaven's Will did not preserve the power of the Immortal King after devouring it and directly used it to strengthen this universe, did it mean that this was the universe he came from?
After all, generally speaking, a Heaven's Will would only strengthen the universe he came from.
This could make the Heaven Heart Mist even denser and stronger.
If that was really the case, as long as they destroyed this universe, they could also kill this Heaven's Will that had grasped the Heaven Heart Mist.
This was a great merit!
At this moment, the space here distorted slightly.
A figure appeared out of thin air.
His gaze instantly locked onto the light curtain and he smiled. "Interesting. Is he strengthening this universe?"
​ Cheng Shang immediately bowed respectfully and said, "Greetings, Supreme Venerate Wujue."
Cheng Yuan's body was unable to move, but he still said very respectfully, "I'm Cheng Yuan. I'm currently trapped by the Heaven Heart Mist and can't bow. Please forgive me."
"How difficult is that?" Wujue smiled faintly.
Then, he raised his right hand and gently flicked it at Cheng Yuan. The Heaven Heart Mist that was barely suppressed on his body instantly dissipated. There was no room for resistance at all as it directly disappeared.
"Thank you, Supreme Venerate!" Cheng Yuan immediately bowed extremely respectfully to Wujue.
"Supreme Venerate, the situation is urgent. Please destroy this universe and kill this Heaven's Will," Cheng Shang said anxiously.
"Alright." Wujue nodded and chuckled. "Actually, I'm already making a move. It's just that with your cultivation realm, you can't tell."
"Ah?" Cheng Shang was stunned when he heard this, and dense doubts surged in his heart.
Already made a move?
Was the effect actually so calm?
This was to destroy a universe! He could do it so easily?!
The Peak Immortal King realm was not this powerful, right?
"Heh." When Wujue saw Cheng Shang's expression, he laughed and asked, "You've never seen a Peak Immortal King destroy a universe?"
"I've embarrassed myself in front of Supreme Venerate. I've indeed never seen it before," Cheng Shang said very sincerely. "It's my fortune to be able to see Supreme Venerate use a supreme divine power to destroy a universe."
"There's no need to flatter me." Immortal King Wujue shook his head and said with a smile, "Actually, destroying a universe is indeed not difficult for a Peak Immortal King, but it's not as exaggerated as you think.
Do you think that to destroy a universe, you need to have power comparable to or even stronger than the entire universe?"
"…" Cheng Shang fell silent when he heard this. He asked curiously, "Isn't that so?"
"Of course not." Immortal King Wujue shook his head and said, "Compared to the size of the entire universe, even a Peak Immortal King is far inferior. Only by taking another step forward and becoming an Invincible Immortal King can one possess power on par with a universe.
There's actually a shortcut to destroying a universe. After breaking through to the Peak Immortal King realm, one will naturally comprehend it. It's not a special method. Since we happened to meet this time, there's no harm in telling you.
You should know that there are many Origin Great Daos in a universe. The core Origin Great Dao will manifest as the Point of Origin. If you want to destroy a universe, you can start from the Point of Origin.

chapters.title: Chapter 689 Legacy Of The Supreme God Of Heaven, The End Of The Path To The Return To Void Realm (3)
chapters.content:
"Origin Great Daos that manifests as the Point of Origin of different universes are usually different, but there's also a point that must be the same. That is, there must be an Origin Great Dao that represents 'matter' that is limited to the origin. This might be the Origin of Five Elements, the Origin of Four Symbols (Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, Black Tortoise), the Origin of Particles, the Origin of Stars, and so on. Their essence symbolizes an existence on the material level of the universe.
As long as we destroy this Origin Great Dao's Point of Origin, it will collapse, and the entire universe will collapse on the physical level.
And matter is the foundation of all existence in the world. The Great Dao, laws, time, space, and so on have to be reflected by matter. Once matter collapses, everything will collapse.
In this way, the entire universe will fall into an unstoppable destruction. It will first turn into nothingness and return to chaos."
"I see. Thank you for your guidance, Supreme Venerate!" Cheng Shang bowed and thanked him in extreme surprise. Then, he said, "Supreme Venerate, I remember that one of the Point of Origin of this universe is formed from the Origin of Stars."
"That's good." Wujue nodded and said with a smile, "The Point of Origin formed by the Origin of Stars is much less mysterious than the Origin of Five Elements, Four Symbols, and so on. It's one of the Origin Great Dao that's most inclined towards materialization.
Such an Origin Great Dao turning into a Point of Origin will make the physical attributes of the entire universe extremely vital. When this Point of Origin is destroyed, the speed at which it collapses will also be faster.
Speaking of which, I've destroyed such a universe before and even refined some of the power of the Origin of Stars. Its power is not bad. This time, I can strengthen this power."
At this point, he suddenly paused and said with a smile, "My Immortal King power has already descended through the Myriad Heavens Palace to the Point of Origin of that universe.
"Next, it's time to set off a big firecracker."
... .
The moment the boundless Immortal King power entered this universe, Cui Heng sensed it.
Then, he realized that this Immortal King power was actually rushing towards the Point of Origin formed by the Origin of Stars.
At this moment, all the Cui Hengs stopped what they were doing and looked in the same direction.
Whether it was Cui Heng, who was comprehending the Origin of Stars, Cui Heng, who was observing Han Shenyi in the Immortal Land and analyzing the Heaven Heart Mist, the countless Cui Hengs in the Netherworld, or the countless other fake Cui Hengs, they were all like this.
As long as there was any abnormality with this Immortal King power, all the Cui Hengs would attack at the same time!
However, Wujue was still in the Myriad Heavens Palace in the Primordial World. Only his Immortal King power had descended here, so it was naturally impossible for him to sense Cui Heng's gaze.
Therefore, this Immortal King power still arrived at the Origin of Stars, which was where Cui Heng was undergoing his final comprehension.
As long as he completed his comprehension of the origin of the star, he would reach the end of the path of the Return to Void realm.
Next, he only needed to use the three Origin Great Daos as the foundation and evolve 480 million laws to obtain a High-grade Return to Void foundation and break through to the Early-stage Return to Void Realm.
However, at the critical moment, an inexhaustible Immortal King power arrived at the Point of Origin formed by the Origin of Stars and headed straight for the core. Clearly, it wanted to wreak havoc on this Point of Origin.
Faced with such a situation, Cui Heng attacked.
Following the passageway that he had traced back through the power in Han Shenyi's body, his Dharmic powers at the Half-step Return to Void Realm erupted. The mixed Dharmic powers that had fused with the Origins of Life and Death instantly sealed this passageway.
This directly cut off the connection between the Immortal King power and Wujue, preventing Wujue from continuing to project his Immortal King power into this universe.
However, even this portion of Immortal King power that had lost "assistance" was extremely powerful.
Although this Immortal King power could no longer threaten the current Cui Heng, it was enough to destroy the Point of Origin formed by the Origin of Stars.
At that time, the entire universe would face a calamity.
Therefore, just as this Immortal King power was rampaging through the Point of Origin, Cui Heng came to the core of the Point of Origin, preparing to destroy the invading Immortal King power here.
However, after the Immortal King power surged in, it did not immediately start destroying everything. Instead, it emitted endless starlight and actually began to mobilize the power of the Origin of Stars, evolving into the scene of countless stars being born and destroyed. It was even showing the scene of the birth and development of the universe.
This was simply the ultimate mystery of the Origin of Stars.
Cui Heng was extremely surprised by this sudden situation.
At this moment, the mysteries of the Origin of Stars were actually presented in such a strange situation in front of him and reflected in the eyes of countless "him".
In just a short moment, Cui Heng's comprehension of the Origin of Stars had reached the Grand Completion stage from the Beginner stage.
At the same time, the spell he had specially deduced for the Origin of Stars, the Heavenly Cycle Star Divine Incantation, advanced by leaps and bounds.
This led Cui Heng's comprehension of the Origin of Stars Great Dao to increase again.
Hence, after this Peak Immortal King power triggered the power of the Origin of Stars, Cui Heng completed his comprehension of this Point of Origin in just a few breaths.
At this point, Cui Heng had finally completed his comprehension of the three Points of Origin and understood the truth of this world. He had reached the end of the path to the Return to Void Realm.
In front of him was the Return to Void Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 690 Soul Refinement, Observing Primordial Chaos Like A Sea Of Bitterness, Under The River Of Time, The Heartless Heavens Are Everlasting
chapters.content:
At the same time that Cui Heng completed his comprehension of the Origin of Stars.
All his fake selves sensed it, and their eyes became incomparably deep. The aura on his body suddenly rose.
It was as if he had instantly sublimated to an endless height and transcended to another level.
"The Origin of Stars is the physical manifestation of this universe. It is the foundation of the existence of this universe. The Origin of Life is the beginning of this universe, and the Origin of Death is the end of this universe."
Cui Heng muttered to himself and finally sighed softly. "All worlds must be based on the existence of matter. All worlds can't escape the beginning and end. This is the truth of the world."
With this sigh, all the Cui Heng in the universe lit up with an incomparably bright light. Billions of lights and shadows spread out from each of Cui Heng's bodies.
These lights and shadows had different identities, different origins, different appearances, and different cultivation levels, but they had the same source, which was the one and only Cui Heng.
At the same time, the Origin Great Dao of Life, Death, and Stars transformed into countless tiny origin worlds, evolving into seemingly endless laws and principles that began to fuse with the billions of lights and shadows.
He was using the three Origin Great Daos as the foundation to evolve 480 million laws and letting the 480 million fake selves carry these laws.
Cui Heng had officially crossed the path of the Return to Void Realm and broken through the limit of the Half-step Return to Void Realm.
He began to truly break through to the Return to Void Realm!
… .
There was silence in the Myriad Heavens Palace.
There was still no movement from the light curtain that revealed Cui Heng's universe. From the various states detected, this universe seemed to be very normal.
There were no signs of destruction.
The "big fireworks" mentioned by Immortal King Wujue just now did not seem to exist.
Could it be that it was still developing?
Everyone was puzzled.
However, some people had an ominous feeling.
Could it be that the "ignition" had failed?
However, Immortal King Wujue was clearly very confident just now.
Moreover, with his cultivation realm, as long as he used the right technique, it should not be too difficult to destroy this universe.
How did this happen?
Everyone was very puzzled.
However, at this moment, neither Cheng Shang nor Cheng Yuan dared to make a sound.
Everyone from the Myriad Heavens Palace shut their mouths. They lowered their heads and held their breaths, not saying a word.
The sound of Immortal King Wujue's voice vowing to set off "big fireworks" had yet to dissipate.
The current situation was really a little awkward.
"It actually failed?!"
At this moment, Immortal King Wujue suddenly spoke.
He was the first to break the silence. He frowned as he looked at the light curtain, his expression filled with confusion.
He had clearly projected his Immortal King power into the Origin power of matter in this universe. Why were there no signs of the Point of Origin collapsing and exploding, and the matter of the entire universe collapsing and crumbling?
"Could it be that the Heaven's Will in this universe is actually about to advance the Heaven Heart Mist into light? That's a terrifying existence comparable to a Quasi Immortal Emperor."
When Immortal King Wujue thought of this, his expression became a little nervous, as if he was a little uneasy.
The current situation was clearly beyond his expectations.
"Supreme Venerate Wujue…" At this moment, Cheng Shang carefully came over and asked, "Did you discover anything?"
He knew better than to ask about the "big fireworks", but he also voiced his doubts.
"It's nothing." Immortal King Wujue shook his head gently. After sneering for a while, he said in a low voice, "This big firework is a little special. Looks like I have to add more firepower!"
As he spoke, he was about to project another ball of Immortal King power into the universe's Point of Origin.
But at this moment, the scene on the light curtain suddenly changed drastically.
Countless strange purple-gold lights appeared and lit up everywhere in the universe without warning, as if an extremely powerful force was displaying its power.
"What is this?!" Immortal King Wujue was shocked and immediately spread his spiritual perception to investigate this universe. Then, his expression changed drastically as he said in shock, "This aura, what kind of energy is this?!"
At this moment, in his perception, an extremely powerful aura was rapidly expanding in this universe.
In the blink of an eye, it had already reached one-tenth of the size of the entire universe.
This was only the physical size of the energy. The divine aura emitted by it was even more incomprehensible to Immortal King Wujue.
"Immortal, indestructible, eternal… What kind of existence is this? Even a Quasi Immortal Emperor doesn't have such an exaggerated aura."
Immortal King Wujue was horrified. What was happening in this universe had completely exceeded his understanding. It was simply unheard of.
At this moment, Cheng Shang and Cheng Yuan, who were at the side, also sensed the powerful aura spreading in this universe. Their eyes immediately widened in disbelief.
However, their cultivation realms were far inferior to Immortal King Wujue's. After the initial shock, they felt that their souls had suffered a huge impact and were directly shocked by this aura until their faces turned pale.
Especially Cheng Yuan, he took a few steps back on the spot. He looked at the scene on the light curtain with his mouth agape and said in shock, "This, what exactly happened in this universe?!"
"It's difficult to investigate what happened there, but…" Immortal King Wujue frowned and stared at the scene displayed on the light curtain, "Perhaps something big is going to happen!"
… .
In the universe where Cui Heng was, every corner of the universe was undergoing a tremendous change.

chapters.title: Chapter 691 Soul Refinement, Observing Primordial Chaos Like A Sea Of Bitterness, Under The River Of Time, The Heartless Heavens Are Everlasting (2)
chapters.content:
As Cui Heng evolved the 480 million laws, all the laws in the entire universe, even the Origin Great Daos, were triggered, revealing countless phenomena. There were scenes of chaos surging, the creation of the Primordial Chaos, the birth of the universe, the destruction of the world, the cycle of life and death, the changes of the five elements, the starlight turning into a sea, the Golden Crow glorious sun, the Karmic Fire burning the Heavens, the Golden Lotus of the Sea of Bitterness, and so on.
These were all natural phenomena caused by the evolution of laws.
At this moment, no matter where one was in this universe, they could clearly see these phenomena and feel the fearsome power contained in them.
The appearance of these phenomena also allowed this universe to quickly expand outwards. It quickly absorbed the Chaotic Qi in the Chaos Sea and transformed it into its own body, making space, matter, laws, and so on more abundant.
The size and essence of the entire universe had increased.
To all living beings, this was a huge opportunity.
As long as a cultivator stepped into the Dao Realm, they could clearly sense the sublimation and changes of the universe and find a direction that was compatible with the laws they cultivated. They could take advantage of this sublimation to increase their cultivation.
As for those living beings who had yet to step into the Dao Realm, because of the sublimation and changes of the universe this time, their potential and foundation would increase, making their future cultivation path smoother and the upper limit of their innate talent higher.
At the same time, in places that most people could not see, countless human figures flew or walked out of the void. They instantly scattered to every corner of the universe and began to fuse with the various phenomena.
These were all Cui Heng's fake selves. They were compatible with the phenomena that spread throughout the universe, which was to say, they were fusing with the 480 million laws that Cui Heng had evolved.
In the end, he could gather these fake selves that contained 480 million laws into one and reach the High-Grade Return to Void Realm!
… .
In the Third Heaven World.
Jin Lingshi, Lord Changsheng, King Haoran, and the other experts above the Dao Realm became incomparably excited.
These phenomena were clearly caused by the power of Immortal Cui Heng.
With such power, no enemy would be his match.
The fellow who came to provoke this universe was definitely going to die!
… .
In the Immortal Land.
​ Daoist Su looked at the sky in a daze and exclaimed, "Did he break through again? How many years has it been since his last breakthrough? What kind of existence is Immortal Cui Heng?!"
At this moment, he could not help but recall the first time he had noticed Cui Heng's breakthrough phenomenon and asked his Dao child to invite Cui Heng to the Immortal Heavenly Dao Realm Dharma Banquet. It was as if a lifetime had passed since then.
Although Cui Heng was already incomparably powerful at that time, the current breakthrough phenomenon was even more exaggerated, ridiculous, and incomprehensible.
He really did not know what Immortal Cui Heng's limits were.
… .
Fang Jian and Immortal Monarch Chonghe looked at the phenomenon in the sky in disbelief.
The current situation was completely beyond their expectations.
The main reason was that the power Cui Heng displayed was too powerful.
Now, this mysterious phenomenon that filled the universe made it impossible for them to guess what realm Cui Heng was in and what strength he had.
They could only roughly confirm that even an existence that had stepped into the Peak Immortal King realm could not have such exaggerated power.
"Could it be that Immortal Master Cui Heng is about to become an Invincible Immortal King?" Immortal Monarch Chonghe could not help but sigh. "That's a powerhouse that's second only to a Quasi Immortal Emperor in the Immortal King realm."
Fang Jian opened his mouth and muttered, "Do we need to bring such a powerful existence to seek refuge?"
"Take refuge?" Immortal Monarch Chonghe shook his head and looked at the sky with some worry. "There's no place for such a powerful existence to take refuge because there's almost no one on our side who's stronger than him.
"However, Immortal Cui Heng's situation should still be very dangerous. If the Quasi Immortal Emperors or even Immortal Emperors of the Primordial World find out about the situation here, they will probably descend and attack at all costs."
"Immortal Emperor?!" Fang Jian said in shock, "Then what should we do?"
"After Immortal Cui Heng completes his breakthrough, I'll leave this place to look for Master Jiu and ask for reinforcements," Immortal Monarch Chonghe said in a low voice. "Although Immortal Cui Heng is powerful, he's the only powerful existence in this universe. It's still very dangerous for him to face the threat of the Primordial World."
"Then I'll stay here and remind Immortal Cui Heng," Fang Jian said in a low voice with a firm gaze.
… .
In Human Emperor Imperial City.
Hong Fugui looked at the layers of phenomena and light in the sky, his expression filled with surprise. He muttered, "Teacher's cultivation has actually reached such a level. It's really unbelievable!"
The countless phenomena that filled the universe began to sublimate the entire universe. His cultivation realm also received an incomparably huge increase, saving him countless hard work.
Although Cui Heng was already an omnipotent existence in his heart, every time he saw Cui Heng break through, he could not hide the shock in his heart.
He did not know when he would be able to catch up to his teacher. Even if he could just obtain one ten-thousandth of his teacher's strength, it was enough.
At this moment, Wang Ren and Zhu Xian, who were standing beside him, were also dumbfounded as they looked at the phenomena in the sky. They felt that their previous choice was incomparably wise.
Fortunately, they had chosen to submit!
Facing such a powerful existence, so what if he could barely hold on for a short period of time?
In the end, they would still collapse.
Only by submitting would they have a bright future!
Only then could they live.
… .
In the Heaven Realm of the Silver Disc Star Sea.
Li Mingqiong, Pei Qingshu, Hui Shi, and the others were also watching the phenomena that filled the sky.
At this moment, they had already sensed Cui Heng's familiar aura from these phenomena.
Hence, it was very clear who was breaking through and who was shaking the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 692 Soul Refinement, Observing Primordial Chaos Like A Sea Of Bitterness, Under The River Of Time, The Heartless Heavens Are Everlasting (3)
chapters.content:
"Master's cultivation realm is getting higher and higher!" Li Mingqiong could not help but sigh. At this moment, she was carefully looking at the various phenomena in the sky. There was a phenomenon that symbolizes the power of the light of humanity—the lights of myriad families!
It was also called the Light of Civilization!
If she could comprehend some of the mysteries of this phenomenon, it would be enough to help her no longer have any bottlenecks before she stepped into the Twelfth True World Realm.
Pei Qingshu was also staring fixedly at the sky. He was also comprehending the mysteries contained in the phenomenon and could not help but sigh. "We're too far away from Master now!"
"That's right." Hui Shi stood at the side and nodded. He sighed softly. "We're too far away."
… .
In a desolate Star Sea.
The living beings here had already been killed by Han Shenyi, and Han Shenyi's body and soul had already been destroyed. It had all turned into nourishment for this universe.
Heaven's Will stood in the void as a humanoid figure. His eyes stared at the omnipresent phenomena. A faint light flickered slightly, as if his thoughts were constantly spinning.
Suddenly, this Heaven's Will laughed, and his face was filled with dense joy. Then, he cried again and clapped his hands as he laughed. "Good, good, this is great!"
… .
Cui Heng felt that his current state was very strange.
After completing the 480 million laws and using his fake selves to carry them, he felt that he seemed to have completely transcended this universe.
The fake selves replaced his position and size in the universe. He seemed to have arrived at an endless height and had a higher dimension perspective.
From this perspective, he could actually look down on the entire universe. Beyond this universe was the endless Chaos Sea.
Balls of light floated in the vast Chaos Sea. Each of them was a universe.
It was boundless and innumerable.
"Is this the Boundless Chaos Sea and the Immeasurable Universe?" Cui Heng thought to himself. "I'm only in the process of breaking through to the Return to Void realm and have actually transcended the universe. Hmm? This is…"
At this moment, he suddenly sensed something and turned to look at a ball of light floating in the Chaos Sea. It was a universe adjacent to his universe.
Just now, he could only look down from the outside and could not sense the situation inside.
But now, he felt as if he had personally descended into that universe and could clearly sense everything in this universe.
Whether it was the deepest Origin Great Dao, the Point of Origin, the Heaven Earth Origin Qi on the surface, or the natural laws, he knew everything in his heart.
"It's a fake self!" Cui Heng understood and was a little surprised. "So that's how it is. A fake self was born in another universe.
After stepping into the Return to Void Realm, my existence will no longer be limited to a single universe. Fake selves will be born in different universes. It's equivalent to existing in different universes at the same time.
As time passes, my fake selves will increase indefinitely and appear in more universes.
I'm everywhere, yet belong to a single point in the Myriad Worlds. This is one of the characteristics of the Return to Void Realm."
After understanding this, Cui Heng felt the essence of his life begin to sublimate again, and the scene he saw changed. An extremely strong light entered his eyes.
This light was projected from an endless distance and floated in the middle of the endless Chaos Sea, illuminating the surrounding gray area.
In this light, he saw countless illusory concepts, beginning, source, origin, and so on. It was as if this was the source of everything.
"This is the Primordial World." Cui Heng instantly made a judgment.
At the same time, he discovered that the Boundless Chaos Sea and the Immeasurable Universe had wrapped around the Primordial World tightly, preventing it from expanding outwards, completely locking down its development space.
This basically matched the information he had obtained earlier.
Crash!
At this moment, Cui Heng suddenly heard the sound of illusory water flowing.
He looked down and saw an illusory bright silver river flowing past his feet. Moreover, it had already drowned his calves and kept washing over him.
In the water of the bright silver river, Cui Heng saw scenes of what had happened in the past. Some of them he knew and some that he did not, were now presented in front of him.
This illusory bright silver river seemed to represent time flowing forward and washing away everything in the past. By looking at the water flow inside, one could pry into the past.
"The River of Time?" Cui Heng muttered.
However, he quickly realized that the past he could pry into was very vague.
This was because when the water washed past his legs, it would become distorted, so he naturally could not restore the original scene.
This should be a manifestation of an illusory concept. Be it my legs or this illusory river of time, it should be like this."
Cui Heng thought to himself, "The essence of its meaning is that I'm still being washed away by time. Since I'm submerged in the River of Time, I can't perfectly pry into the past."
After understanding this, he completed the breakthrough to the Return to Void Realm.
It was also at the moment of this breakthrough that the illusory River of Time under Cui Heng's perspective suddenly expanded. It actually covered the entire Chaos Sea and the Immeasurable Universe, including the Primordial World.
Vast bright silver river water surged from the settled past and flowed towards the uncertain future.
From this perspective, Cui Heng saw that the Boundless Chaos Sea was like mud in the river, the Immeasurable Universe was like a pebble in the mud, and the Primordial World was like an island.
Countless shadows of living beings were reflected by the river water, and their experiences from life to death were reflected in Cui Heng's eyes.
There were mortals and Immortals among them. Their identities and origins were different, and their life's levels were different. However, they were all struggling bitterly, and without exception, they were all flowing towards death. This illusory river that enveloped the Chaos Sea was like a huge sea of suffering, but there was no shore.
Suddenly, Cui Heng sensed something and looked down.
He could not move his feet at all when he stepped on the bottom of the "river". He could only let his legs be washed by this illusory river and let time corrode them before finally dying.
"So I'm also in the Sea of Bitterness and struggling. So this is the Return to Void realm." Cui Heng's eyes became deep as he muttered through the sparkling river water.
It transcends the universe and stands at an endless height. It has the ability to control the laws of the universe at will. It is supreme and eternal like the sky.
But at this realm, one can see the truth that they don't know through the illusory river of time.
"Time washes away everything, and it will destroy everything.
Any Immortal that has not transcended the scouring of time just has an illusionary feeling of themselves.
After returning to the void, there's the Sea of Bitterness.
If the Heavens are heartless, it will be everlasting. If the Heavens have emotions, the Heavens will age."

chapters.title: Chapter 693 Changes After The Return To Void Realm, Juntian's Past
chapters.content:
Under the scouring of time, all living beings struggled and all living beings sank into the Sea of Bitterness.
Even the power and divinity of a Return to Void cultivator would eventually age and perish.
Only by transcending time and completely stepping out of the River of Time could one truly achieve Immortality.
Cui Heng retracted his gaze from the Sea of Bitterness and thought to himself, "To completely step out of the River of Time and achieve transcendence on the level of time. This should be the cultivation goal of the Return to Void Realm.
However, as for how to cultivate, I can only confirm it after reading the High-level Immortal Technique, From Initiate to Ascension. I still have to deal with some things now."
Thinking of this, he descended to the universe below and adjusted his aura to a certain extent.
After Cui Heng stepped into the Early-stage Return to Void Realm, the essence of his existence had already been sublimated to the extreme. In his normal state, he was already a higher existence than the universe. What existed in the universe could only be his fake self.
Simply put, he had already become an existence that transcended the universe. What remained in the universe would only be his projection.
Of course, his main body could also enter the universe, but if he entered directly, it would directly disturb the dimensional state of the entire universe and it was very likely that the entire universe would collapse.
Therefore, he needed to put on a layer of disguise to mask himself as the essence of the universe to avoid exerting influence on the universe.
In this way, he could descend into the universe normally.
However, the moment Cui Heng's main body descended into the universe, there was still a "little" turbulence.
The entire universe seemed to have been stirred by an invisible force. Countless laws instantly appeared and formed, condensing into countless ribbons of light of different colors that flowed in the starry sky.
A similar scene played out in every corner of the universe.
This also meant that the laws of the entire universe had been stirred up by an invisible force, causing such a situation.
At the same time, various phenomena appeared with the Origin Great Daos.
The three core Origin Great Daos directly revealed their Point of Origin.
Around Cui Heng, phenomena such as flowers falling from the sky, golden lotuses surging from the ground, and Immortal music appeared.
These phenomena and the many situations manifested by the laws and Great Dao seemed to be the entire universe welcoming his arrival.
It was very magical.
During this process, Cui Heng himself was not idle.
He was carefully experiencing the changes in his current state.
After all, he had only just entered the Return to Void Realm. There were many things that he had to experience on his own.
For example, this change in the universe.
Although it looked like this universe was welcoming his arrival, the reason why these phenomena appeared was because he was too powerful and had forcefully entered this universe.
Even Cui Heng, who had just stepped into the Early-stage Return to Void Realm, was already close to a complete universe in terms of his Dharmic powers and physical body. As long as some new fake selves were born, his body would surpass the level of a complete universe.
With such a powerful body, when he forcefully squeezed into this universe, it was naturally inevitable that it would stir up the laws and Great Dao of the entire universe.
Simply put, Cui Heng was too 'big'. Although this universe could withstand it, it would still produce some relatively intense reactions because he had forcefully squeezed in.
That was why those phenomena appeared.
However, after Cui Heng entered, this universe would slowly adapt and gradually become 'loose and smooth'. The reaction of the laws and Great Dao would gradually weaken, and the countless phenomena would naturally dissipate.
When Cui Heng returned to the Immortal Land world in the middle of the Silver Disc Star Sea, the nomological Great Dao of this universe had already completely adapted to his entry and even began to cater to him. There were no more phenomena.
Cui Heng returned to the Human Emperor Palace as usual.
Hong Fugui sensed something and immediately came out to greet him.
At the same time, Daoist Su and Immortal Monarch Chonghe also sensed something and immediately walked out. Although Fang Jian did not sense the situation, he followed the two of them outside.
"Congratulations, Teacher. Your cultivation has improved again!" Hong Fugui was the first to kneel in front of Cui Heng.
"Congratulations on your breakthrough, Exalted Immortal!" Daoist Su, Immortal Monarch Chonghe, and Fang Jian followed closely behind.
"There's no need to be so polite." Cui Heng waved his hand gently and got everyone to stand up. His gaze landed on Fang Jian and Immortal Monarch Chonghe and he smiled. "What are your plans next?"
Fang Jian and Immortal Monarch Chonghe fell silent.
Previously, they came here because they were worried about Cui Heng's safety and wanted to bring him to another universe to take refuge.
However, from the looks of Cui Heng's breakthrough just now,
They were thinking too much.
Cui Heng was too powerful, so powerful that they found it unbelievable.
In this way, they could not provide him a place to take refuge at all.
However, Immortal Monarch Chonghe had already made plans before this. He cupped his hands and bowed. "Exalted Immortal, I plan to leave this universe and seek reinforcements."
"Reinforcements?" Cui Heng smiled when he heard that. "Do you think my current situation is still very dangerous?"
"Yes." Immortal Monarch Chonghe nodded solemnly and said, "The Primordial World is powerful and has a large number of Quasi Immortal Emperors and Immortal Emperor experts. I'm afraid they won't let you continue to become stronger. If there's no expert comparable to an Immortal Emperor here, your situation will still be a little dangerous."
"What kind of realm is an Immortal Emperor?" Cui Heng asked.
Previously, he had learned about the vague framework of the Primordial World in the "Legend of Haojun". The cultivation system listed was only limited to the name and he did not understand much information.

chapters.title: Chapter 694 Changes After The Return To Void Realm, Juntian's Past (2)
chapters.content:
"I only heard rumors about the power of an Immortal Emperor," Immortal Monarch Chonghe said in a low voice. "It's said that Immortal Emperors have methods to stir time. They can even cross space and time to attack. Their power is unbelievable and incomprehensible." Cross space and time to attack?!
Cui Heng's expression became solemn.
He had just reached the realm where he could see the River of Time and spy on the past.
There was definitely a considerable gap to cross before he could transcend space and time to attack.
He was probably no match for an Immortal Emperor.
"Since an Immortal Emperor is so powerful, where can you ask for help?" Cui Heng asked in a low voice.
This was also to investigate the situation of the Immeasurable Universe.
"There's a Heaven's Will Supreme Venerate who can compete with an Immortal Emperor," Immortal Monarch Chonghe explained. "A few Heaven's Will experts who have grasped the Heaven Heart Light are also on our side."
Then, he explained to Cui Heng what the power of Heaven Heart was.
"The strange white smoke used by the Heaven's Will to devour Han Shenyi earlier is the Heaven Heart Mist?" Cui Heng looked at the sky. Suddenly, he raised his eyebrows slightly and smiled. "Speak of the devil."
At this moment, an extremely powerful aura descended from outside the Immortal Land.
A pure white light crossed the void and arrived in front of Cui Heng in the blink of an eye.
This aura contained extremely powerful Origin power, and there were many types, as if it contained everything.
It was simply like a living being nurtured from the power of the Origin Great Daos.
However, this Origin power was a little different from the Origin Great Dao of this universe. It did not seem to come from the Origin Great Daos of this universe itself. It seemed to have come from another universe.
This huge aura quickly condensed and transformed into the appearance of a middle-aged man. He was wearing a green robe and his hair was disheveled as he slowly walked over.
Daoist Su standing at the side immediately exclaimed when he saw this person's appearance. He said in shock, "Venerate Juntian?!"
Cui Heng's eyes narrowed slightly as he stared at the middle-aged man who had suddenly appeared. He smiled and said, "Should I call you Venerate Juntian or Zhou Juntian?"
He had seen Tian Qing impersonating Venerate Juntian in Prince Lie's memories, and he had also seen the real Venerate Juntian in the "Legend of Haojun". It was this middle-aged man.
However, whether this person was Zhou Juntian was actually still debatable.
"Anything is fine." The middle-aged man nodded and said with a sigh, "Zhou Juntian's identity should be the most unforgettable incarnation of mine."
At this point, he paused slightly and bowed to Cui Heng. "Thank you, Exalted Immortal, for killing Hao Jun. Otherwise, I wouldn't have been able to return to this universe."
"Oh?" Cui Heng raised his eyebrows slightly, and bright silver ripples appeared in his eyes. He saw the layers of phantoms on this middle-aged man and came to a realization. "I see."
Just now, he had entered the special perspective of the Return to Void Realm and investigated the middle-aged man's past through his prying into the River of Time.
Moreover, because he already knew a lot of information about Zhou Juntian and Venerate Juntian, the shadows that could only be vaguely seen became clearly visible.
Cui Heng saw all of this middle-aged man's past experiences.
Juntian was indeed the original Heaven's Will of this universe.
However, not long after he was born, Hao Jun's fragment soul was banished here and directly replaced his position, becoming the Heaven's Will here.
As the Chaos Heaven's Will, Juntian should have been killed, and Hao Jun had indeed done so.
However, because Hao Jun only had a fragment soul and was slightly weaker, he could not annihilate Juntian completely and let a portion of Juntian escape.
This portion of Heaven's Will left this universe and absorbed power from other universes, developing step by step.
Finally, a billion years ago, he successfully grasped the power of Heaven Heart and condensed the Heaven Heart Mist, possessing strength equivalent to a Top Immortal King.
This way, he had the confidence to counterattack.
However, although Hao Jun was only an Ordinary Immortal King, there was a huge organization behind him.
There was no lack of Peak Immortal Kings and even Invincible Immortal Kings among them.
Therefore, Juntian planned to wait another billion years. After the Heaven Heart Mist evolved into the Heaven Heart Light, he would have strength comparable to a Quasi Immortal Emperor.
At that time, he could launch a counterattack.
But he quickly realized that this plan wouldn't work.
That was because his own strength and foundation all came from non-native universes, and he did not exist as the Heaven's Will in his original universe.
This caused him to be unable to completely grasp the power of the Heaven Heart Mist, nor could he evolve it into a Heaven Heart Light.
After a billion years, his Heaven Heart Mist had already reached the limit of its current level. It was only one step away from evolving into Heaven Heart Light.
Juntian should have the strength equivalent to an Invincible Immortal King.
However, in reality, he still only had the strength equivalent to a Top Immortal King. He had not even reached the Peak Immortal King level.
This made Juntian understand that if he wanted to become stronger, he had to replace the foundation of his strength with the Origin Great Daos of his original universe. He also had to return to his original universe and snatch back the position of Heaven's Will.
