He clearly hasn’t returned to his original appearance, nor has he taken back the essence of Existence.” Beginning’s emotions fluctuated violently, and he could not understand how Cui Heng could have such powerful strength. “No, this technique is too powerful. I can’t fight him head-on!”
He quickly made a decision. After barely dodging the attacks of the Dao Life Sword at a few points in time, he waved his sleeve and sucked the Earth into his sleeve before disappearing without a trace.
Cui Heng’s divine sense covered all the timelines from the beginning of time to the end of time, but he could not find Beginning’s figure at all. He seemed to have left this world or jumped out of the timeline.
However, he quickly determined Beginning’s direction. “The timeline problem of this universe is indeed related to him.”
Previously, after Cui Heng occupied all the timelines of the universe where Earth was, he discovered a problem. The starting point of time here was not the true beginning, and the end of time was not the true end. There were unknown periods before and after.
This was very strange.
Originally, he planned to explore the problem of the timeline after investigating the mysterious substance on Earth.
However, he did not expect to encounter Beginning so quickly and fight with him, learning some secrets that seemed to be related to him.
Now that Beginning was no match for him and had escaped the timeline, he should have entered that unknown time period to avoid his detection.
“From the suppression of the Dao Life Sword on Beginning, the situation he faced should be very dangerous.” Cui Heng looked at the original location of Earth and thought to himself, “At such a critical moment, he didn’t forget to bring Earth with him when he escaped. Was it for the mysterious crystal in the fog at the core of Earth?”
Now, he had already confirmed that the mysterious crystal in the fog at the core of Earth had the same power as the mysterious substance that formed the System. It was very likely that they were originally one and only separated for some reason.
However, from the size of the System, the mysterious substance that formed it far exceeded that mysterious crystal.
It was even greater than the difference between an ordinary star and the entire universe.
“What exactly is this mysterious substance?” Cui Heng fell into deep thought and thought to himself, “During the battle just now, it repeatedly mentioned my ‘true appearance’, as well as ‘Existence’ and the ‘foundation of Existence’. Was he referring to my essence source?”
At this moment, he was already certain that his true source was definitely not just an ordinary orphan on Earth. He must have a deeper background.

chapters.title: Chapter 789 - 789 Dao Integration Tribulation, Mahayana, Origin of the Dao of Immortals of Ancient Times (3)
chapters.content:
789 Dao Integration Tribulation, Mahayana, Origin of the Dao of Immortals of Ancient Times (3)
However, be it the Primordial World or Earth’s universe, he had already occupied all the timelines, but he could not find his origins. It was as if he did not exist at all. “No, that’s not right. There’s still a period of time that I haven’t occupied!” Cui Heng suddenly realized something. His eyes glowed with golden light as they landed on a strange vortex in the River of Time. “I’m completely unfamiliar with this period of time. I’ve never seen it before.”
The “vortex” he was looking at now was a “past time point” that had been forcefully embedded into the “future”.
What happened at this time was that Cui Heng had already been killed.
Something that had never happened before had actually become a fact that had long happened.
In his hurry to escape, Beginning could only take Earth away, but he left behind this strange time period, giving Cui Heng a chance to investigate.
“When I occupied the timeline earlier, there were no traces of this time at all…” Cui Heng raised his hand and grabbed lightly. The vortex separated from the River of Time, turning into countless lights and shadows that intertwined, condensing into a walnut-sized ball of light that landed in his palm. “This should be the time that was specially extracted by Beginning.”
After reaching his realm, he could actually do all kinds of things with the River of Time.
Even if he forcefully pulled a certain period of time out of the River of Time and hid it, it was not a difficult thing. He could even change it and create the situation he wanted.
This strange time was like this. It was clearly the moment after the beginning of time, but there was a history of Cui Heng being killed at the beginning. It was clearly abnormal.
However, if one wanted to affect an expert at Cui Heng’s level, the history fabricated out of thin air would definitely not be effective, let alone reach the level where Cui Heng’s future would be restrained by the “fact” that had been destroyed.
“I’m afraid only subtle changes based on actual facts can achieve such an effect.” Golden light flowed in Cui Heng’s eyes, and his thoughts kept spinning. “The person who was killed at this time is an existence that’s extremely related to me. It’s even possible that it’s my predecessor, my fundamental source?”
As he thought this, he began to organize the actual situation of this time period. He removed the disguise and changes that had been placed on it bit by bit and restored the true history of what had happened at this time.
This process was not complicated. With Cui Heng’s current cultivation, he quickly completed it.
When he saw the original appearance of this time period, he was stunned for a long time. After a while, he came back to his senses and slowly closed his eyes, muttering, “So that’s how it is, so that’s how it is!”
At this moment, he had already understood everything.
After Cui Heng understood the reason for everything, the mysterious substance that was originally hidden in the form of the System suddenly began to melt and fuse with his body and soul.
At the same time, the various Great Dao laws that Cui Heng had evolved from his cultivation also changed. Under the influence of the mysterious substance fusion, they began to sublimate to the extreme. Be it their essence or power, they actually began to advance to a higher level.
“So this is the Dao Integration realm. It combines my own Dao of evolution and my original Dao.”
Cui Heng’s entire body emitted endless light. The original Great Dao ball of light had already transformed into the light of the Great Dao that could carry everything. Not only did it illuminate the universe that Earth was in, but it also illuminated the Primordial World on the other side and the Boundless Chaos Universe.
To him, there were no longer any obstacles in the worlds on both sides. He could exist anywhere in these two worlds at the same time, or he could exist in any timeline of these two worlds at the same time. He was omnipresent in all space-time.
Even the original blank period, the unknown time after the end and before the beginning, was reflected in Cui Heng’s eyes. It was no longer mysterious.
“However, it can’t be considered a complete Dao Integration yet. I still have a portion of my Dao foundation in Beginning’s hands.” Cui Heng’s gaze landed on the unknown time period and saw Beginning who was hiding there. However, he did not take action immediately. Instead, he returned to Jiang Qiqi’s side.
At this moment, Jiang Qiqi had just witnessed Cui Heng’s sublimation and said in surprise, “Big Brother Immortal, did you… break through again?”
“I’ve improved a little.” Cui Heng smiled and said, “If I want to take another step forward, I still need to take something from you.”
Then, he gently grabbed in front of Jiang Qiqi and extracted a wisp of subtle aura from her body. It was the so-called “power of Existence” that had been placed by Beginning and erupted from her body.
This was not a power that belonged to Jiang Qiqi to begin with. Although she had fused a portion of it with her by chance, it was not one with her body after all, and she did not take the initiative to control it. Therefore, after Cui Heng pulled out this aura, Jiang Qiqi did not even feel anything unusual.
Then, Cui Heng took a light breath and this wisp of aura fused into his body again, causing his Dao Integration realm to become even more perfected.
“So the power in my body belongs to Big Brother Immortal?” Jiang Qiqi asked curiously.
“It’s the aura of power that was once intercepted by someone.” Cui Heng chuckled and said, “At first, he wanted to use you all as bait to fish me out. It’s just that he didn’t expect that you could actually fuse with a portion of the power of this aura by chance, causing his plan to fail.”
“Us all?” Jiang Qiqi asked curiously.
“Yes, there are also a few other people who entered my cultivation place. It’s not a coincidence.” Cui Heng nodded slightly and raised his hand to grab lightly again. He absorbed another five wisps of aura and fused them into his body.
These five wisps of aura came from Hong Fugui, Pei Qingshu, Li Mingqiong, Zhong Xianyuan, and Zhou Xuan. Coupled with the wisp of aura he had just extracted from Jiang Qiqi, there were a total of six wisps. They were from the six people who had entered the Beginner’s Space.

chapters.title: Chapter 790 - 790 Dao Integration Tribulation, Mahayana, Origin of the Dao of Immortals of Ancient Times (4)
chapters.content:
790 Dao Integration Tribulation, Mahayana, Origin of the Dao of Immortals of Ancient Times (4)
The reason why they could enter the Beginner’s Space was not because of a chance encounter, but because they carried the aura of power that came from the same source as the essence of the System. They were guided by an invisible force. And these auras of power essentially came from Cui Heng’s predecessor.
Now that Cui Heng had retracted these auras, his Dao Integration realm cultivation had become even more perfected.
His gaze landed on Beginning who was hiding in the mysterious time period and he said indifferently, “It’s time to end this.”
… .
!!
In a boundless and formless place.
This was a mysterious area independent of time. It was the extreme emptiness after the end of time. It was also the origin of everything before the beginning of time, and also the foundation of the existence of everything.
After time ended, the world would enter this mysterious area and use this as the starting point to begin a new timeline.
This cycle continued without stopping.
Under normal circumstances, Beginning could only enter this mysterious space after the Primordial World and the Boundless Chaos Sea reached the final end.
If he occupied the end of time, he should also be able to sense this mysterious area.
The reason why Cui Heng did not sense it in the world over there was because this mysterious area had long been extracted from the Earth’s universe and existed independently.
At first, Beginning had spent endless years rummaging through the River of Time countless times before finally finding a clue. He arrived at Earth’s universe and found this mysterious space that was independent of time.
The arrangements that had been left behind also began to take effect. Just as he was about to successfully obtain that crystal and have a chance to transcend, something happened.
“Why, why is this happening? Why is this happening?!” Beginning muttered in exasperation. “It shouldn’t be like this anymore. He should have been absorbed by me long ago and helped me transcend the Limitless Realm. How did things develop to this state?”
His heart surged with emotions and was filled with resentment, but he did not lose his mind. Instead, he began to think about the entire situation, trying to figure out what had gone wrong.
“The beginning of time symbolizes the appearance of the ‘Foundation of Existence’. As the symbol of the Beginning and End, as long as I absorb the ‘Existence’, I can encompass everything, transcend the boundless, and become an unknown existence.
I benefited from my advantage in the timeline and was able to suppress the newly born “Foundation of Existence”. But I didn’t expect him to actually split up at the last moment and escape. I only retained a portion of his aura and couldn’t absorb him.
However, I knew that as long as I can find his split form and spirit, I can absorb it and walk the path of transcendence. After that, I spent countless years and finally found some clues. It turned out that at the last moment, not only did he separate his form and spirit, he also extracted a portion of space-time and the land of the Ultimate that was the source of the world.
That portion of space-time is attached to the surface of the Ruins of End, forming an infinitely vast universe on a spatial scale. The power of the “Foundation of Existence” is very likely hidden in this universe. Then, I decided to go over and investigate in order to obtain an opportunity to transcend.
As that universe was divided by the power of the ‘Foundation of Existence’, once I entered that universe, I won’t be able to return to the Primordial Lands in a short period of time. It won’t be good if the Foundation of Existence revived in the Primordial Lands, so I left behind some of the aura of power that was left behind from the ‘Foundation of Existence’.
I divided this power aura into 18 portions and took away 12 of them, leaving behind the other six. These portions of power aura will then attach to the living beings, and they will naturally approach the “Foundation of Existence”.
As long as the revived Foundation of Existence absorbs the six portions of power again, I can use the 12 portions of power in my hand to sense it and use it as a spiritual guide to return to the land of origin. At the same time, I can use these 12 portions of power to affect the Foundation of Existence and kill him again.
After making the arrangements and preparations, I came to this infinitely vast universe. When I arrived, I realized that this universe was actually extremely young. In 30 billion years, I reached the end of time and entered the Ruins of End.
It was too difficult to find the Foundation of Existence. Even if I can see the entire world at a glance, I can’t find him directly. I have to search bit by bit. However, every time the time is restarted, this universe will reset. This caused me a lot of trouble to find the clues on the whereabouts of the Foundation of Existence.
Fortunately, after a long search, I finally found the place where the Foundation of Existence was hiding before this time cycle ended. It was a very ordinary-looking living star. At the same time, I confirmed that his “spirit” had reincarnated and was nowhere to be found.
There’s a large amount of fog outside the ‘form’ of the Foundation of Existence, preventing me from approaching it, let alone obtaining the ‘form’ hidden inside. This should be left behind by the Foundation of Existence. For some reason, he actually has such exquisite power. I actually can’t see through it.
After some research, I realized that the fog seemed to only be activated by the power of the Foundation of Existence. If I gathered enough power of Existence, I might be able to draw out the “form” inside. Therefore, I tried to use the 12 wisps of power aura to activate the aura of power from the Primordial Lands.
In the end, a person with the aura of the Foundation of Existence really came to this planet. The increase in this power also made me understand that even if I gathered the complete 18 portions of power, it was not enough to trigger the fog and pull out the “form” inside.
Fortunately, this person’s arrival allowed me to understand something. I sensed the aura of the Foundation of Existence’s spirit, on her body. It’s in her Niwan Palace’s sea of consciousness. This means that the body and soul of the Foundation of Existence are both struggling hard. The form is here, but the spirit has reincarnated in the Primordial Lands on the other side.

chapters.title: Chapter 791 - 791 Dao Integration Tribulation, Mahayana, Origin of the Dao of Immortals of Ancient Times (5)
chapters.content:
791 Dao Integration Tribulation, Mahayana, Origin of the Dao of Immortals of Ancient Times (5)
In that case, I only need to wait. When the reincarnation of the spirit reaches a certain realm, he will naturally seek a higher level and come into contact with the path to this universe. At that time, I felt that I only needed to wait here. After all, that’s only the reincarnation of Existence’s spirit. It’s impossible for him to be my match. So, what went wrong with this entire process? There shouldn’t be a problem. Why didn’t he fuse with the aura of power left there? And how did he become so powerful? He’s just a reincarnation of a spirit that doesn’t have the power of ‘form’ to support him, so he shouldn’t be powerful to this extent.
“Even the ‘Foundation of Existence’ that fused with the body and spirit back then was not so powerful. Now, he hasn’t even grasped the ‘form’ of the Foundation of Existence and has only relied on cultivation to reach this realm. Why is he so powerful? What mistake did I make?”
“The mistake is that you overestimated yourself and underestimated the concept of the Foundation of Existence.” At this moment, Cui Heng’s voice suddenly sounded in the Ruins of End. He slowly walked over and looked down at Beginning.
“From the start, you, who stood at the beginning of time and the end, do not understand the power of civilization and life. The strength of the Foundation of Existence lies in these seemingly weak existences. In fact, they are the true foundation of ‘Existence’. Without civilization and life, ‘Existence’ will not be able to obtain feedback. It will only be a cold concept.”
!!
After understanding his original background, he finally understood the essence of the Immortal cultivation technique.
This was the most suitable cultivation method for him that the “spirit” who had existed for a long time had deduced during his countless reincarnations.
Through sensing, comprehending, and understanding the various civilizations and lives that existed in the world, he could grasp the power of “Existence”.
In a sense, this could also be understood as Refining Void into Reality and Refining False into True.
Therefore, cultivation was also called “cultivation of the truth”.
This was also the fundamental reason why Cui Heng had to comprehend the seven emotions of all living beings, enlighten spirituality, understand the unknown, and so on during the process of cultivation.
When he reached the Peak of the Return to Void Realm, even without fusing with the ‘form’ of the Foundation of Existence, he had already relied on his cultivation to obtain the power of Existence to reach the same level as Beginning and End.
Now that he had fused with most of the “forms” that formed the system, he was already half a step into the Dao Integration realm.
He was just short of snatching back the small portion here.
“Nonsense, this is extremely ridiculous! The living creatures of the world are just ants, and the so-called civilizations are just ant nests. What power can it have?” Beginning shouted coldly, not believing Cui Heng’s words at all. Then, he shouted sternly, “You’re confronting me with such nonsense. Do you really think I’m in a desperate situation?!”
As he spoke, he opened his right hand. A star appeared out of thin air, emitting an extremely dense power of Existence.
It was Earth!
In the next moment, the entire Earth exploded with a bang, turning into countless specks of dust. The thick fog at the core spread out, and one could vaguely see a mysterious crystal flickering with light.
This was the “form” of the foundation that Cui Heng lacked!
At the same time, the power aura in his entire body seemed to be burning as it crazily affected the crystal.
Under the influence of Beginning’s power, the surface of the crystal was actually dyed with a trace of scarlet color, emitting an extremely strange power. It instantly distorted the land of the Ultimate and began to affect Cui Heng’s condition. It actually wanted to weaken Cui Heng’s power.
Cui Heng, who had just descended here, seemed to be greatly affected. He froze there and looked at Beginning in disbelief. He said in shock, “You can actually control its power?!”
“Hahahaha! I’ve succeeded!” Beginning laughed heartily, and the expression on his face kept changing between young and old. He held the crystal in his hand and was rather proud. “In the end, you haven’t retrieved the ‘form’ of the Foundation of Existence. This is the foundation of everything. As long as I control it, I can even affect the reincarnation of a ‘spirit’ like you. You’re finished!”
“Is that so?” Cui Heng suddenly returned to his normal state. At the same time, he raised his hand and pointed lightly at the crystal. Immediately, the scarlet color on the crystal disappeared and flew out of Beginning’s hand to land in his palm. He looked at Beginning with a faint smile. “Do you think this is all the entire ‘form’ of the Foundation of Existence?”
“This, this, how can this be?!” At first, his eyes widened as he looked at the crystal in Cui Heng’s hand in disbelief. He was almost crazy. “This is impossible. Why, why is this happening?!”
“Because this has always been an extremely tiny ‘form’. It’s not the entire ‘form’!” Cui Heng chuckled.
Then, the crystal entered his palm and began to fuse with him. The complete aura of the Foundation of Existence immediately appeared on his body. It was boundless and illuminated the endless world and the entire Ultimate land. Even the endless void was illuminated.
Dao Integration!
At this moment, Cui Heng had already truly stepped into the Dao Integration realm and completely controlled everything. As long as he stepped into this realm, he would reach perfection. It was the pinnacle.
At the same time, he understood what “Tribulation Transcendence” was.
“You coveted me when I was born, and you searched for me after I transcended the tribulation. After I revived, I became your enemy. So this is all my tribulation,” Cui Heng muttered. His gaze landed on Beginning and he sighed softly. “After killing you, I’ll successfully transcend the tribulation and reach the truly perfect Mahayana realm.”
“Ridiculous, don’t even think about killing me!” Beginning gritted his teeth and roared, trying his best to escape. “Back then, if he could escape, there’s no reason why I couldn’t. As long as I…”
However, just as he was about to escape according to the established route, Cui Heng suddenly pressed his palm down, as if he was grabbing a little chick, and he directly grasped this supreme existence that occupied the starting point and end of time in his hand.
Beginning realized that all his divine powers were instantly sealed and he had no ability to resist at all.
This was a complete suppression!
He never dreamed that he would be crushed in all aspects one day.

chapters.title: Chapter 792 - 792 Dao Integration Tribulation, Mahayana, Origin of the Dao of Immortals of Ancient Times, Finale (6)
chapters.content:
792 Dao Integration Tribulation, Mahayana, Origin of the Dao of Immortals of Ancient Times, Finale (6)
“So this is the realm after the Dao Integration realm.” Cui Heng sighed slightly and looked at Beginning who was grasped in his hand. “Just now, I tricked you into burning your strength to control that crystal. I originally wanted to consume a portion of your strength to reduce the difficulty of capturing you, but now it seems that it’s unnecessary.” With that, he covered Beginning with his other palm. Then, he pressed his palms together and rubbed them gently. Beginning’s body and soul were destroyed and he no longer existed. All the space-time in the past, present, and future, even the Ultimate land outside space-time, had no traces of him.
Beginning was dead!
At the same time that Cui Heng killed Beginning, he felt a lightness suddenly surge around his body, as if some negative power that had been wrapped around his body had been washed away. The essence of his life and the nature of his power began to sublimate again.
He had completed the Tribulation Transcendence and reached the Mahayana realm!
“So this is Immortal Ascension.”
Cui Heng muttered.
At this moment, he could clearly feel that he could take another step forward at any time and completely transcend and leave this world, sublimating into an unknown and indescribable existence.
This was the level after Mahayana, which was Immortal Ascension.
“Ordinary cultivation will last until the Peak Return to Void Realm.”
Cui Heng understood in his heart. The three realms of Dao Integration, Tribulation Transcendence, and Mahayana were essentially paths that only he could walk. Only he could reach them, so it was not recorded in the Immortal Technique.
“However, if I transcend and leave one day, the door to these three realms will open to all living beings again.”
… .
After everything was settled, Cui Heng did not directly transcend.
He first restored the originally destroyed Earth to its original state, then sorted out the timeline and returned the space-time that had become chaotic because of the two of them fighting to normal.
Then, he brought Jiang Qiqi back to the Primordial World.
“Big Brother Immortal, is all the danger over?” Jiang Qiqi asked rather happily.
“Yes.” Cui Heng nodded slightly and smiled. “Next, I’ll bring you to meet a few people.”
He brought Jiang Qiqi to see Hong Fugui, Pei Qingshu, and Li Mingqiong. As for Zhong Xianyuan and Zhou Xuan, they could only be said to not be fated to meet.
Cui Heng gathered the four of them together and asked, “I want to reopen the path of cultivation in the world. Are you willing to follow me to the starting point of time and preach to all living beings?”
The reason why he did not choose to directly transcend and leave was because the upper limit of the cultivation path in this world was still at the Immortal Emperor realm. It was far from reaching the end of cultivation.
As the Foundation of Existence, perfecting the cultivation path of the world was a necessary thing, and it was also a way to perfect himself.
Hong Fugui, Jiang Qiqi, Pei Qingshu, and Li Mingqiong naturally knew that this was a huge blessing, so they bowed and thanked him. They followed Cui Heng back to the beginning of time and became the innate Supreme Gods.
Now that the world had just been established, the Primordial Chaos was divided, the Great Dao was obscure, and there were no living beings.
Hence, Cui Heng assigned Hong Fugui to control the sky and laws. Pei Qingshu controlled the land and all the living beings. Li Mingqiong controlled men and created all intelligent species.
After all the living beings in the world stabilized, he established a Dao Palace in the world with Jiang Qiqi accompanying him.
… .
The world that had just been established was a wilderness. All living beings were ignorant and civilization had yet to develop.
On this day, an endless and holy voice suddenly spread throughout the entire world.
“I’ll establish a Dao Palace in the center of the world and start a lecture on the Dao Validation Immortal Technique. All living beings can come and listen!”
(End of book)
